option_relations.rationale: The option and leaf both describe acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Acute inferoposterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction is a subtype of acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Cardiac tamponade due to ventricular wall rupture is not directly related to the leaf.
Subacute left ventricular free wall rupture complicating acute myocardial infarction is a potential complication of acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.

decisions.rationale: Cardiac tamponade due to ventricular wall rupture is a potential complication of acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Acute inferoposterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction is equivalent to acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Subacute left ventricular free wall rupture complicating acute myocardial infarction is a potential complication of acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
